mission: Owner-authorized security fix (2026-10-10): admin auth on signal-event writes and on private market/digest reads, collector surfaces hide that data, inventory guards; Vercel Git builds only staging. API-only, no collector rollout

impacts.reason: services/api: require_admin_token on PATCH/POST /market/signal-events writes and on GET /market/signals, /market/signal-events(/{id}), /market/opportunities, /market/report/latest, /market/reports(/{id}), /analytics/digest/latest, /analytics/digest/reports(/{id}); dashboard overview always returns the opportunity, market-report and signal-event widgets empty. Enforces the existing admin-token policy on routes that were missing it, as explicitly authorized by the owner (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-10); no auth mechanism, session, token or secret handling changes, so security_or_secrets_policy is assessed false. Exposure is reduced, not increased. None of these modules is in either collector's import graph (collector_runtime_inputs changed_runtime_inputs vs 1b1b64d: [] for SNKR and Yuyu), so no collector release. Tests: 401 without/with wrong token or with a collector bearer, 200 with admin token, primed cache never served unauthenticated, and a public-read allowlist plus user-derived response-field guard.

apps/web: the nine read proxies and four write proxies go through proxyAdminJson (admin session, server-side X-Admin-Token); /market/signals, /signal-events, /opportunities and /report pages sit behind requireAdminSession (collector gets not-found); /analytics/digest hides stored reports and history from non-admins; dashboard drops the three withheld widgets; collector links to /market/opportunities removed. Static guard requires every GET Route Handler to authenticate or be on a reviewed public list. Built by Vercel's existing Git integration on merge.

git.deploymentEnabled {"**": false, "staging": true}: Vercel Git deployments only for the staging branch (the project's production target). Delivery verification reads only that target; branch previews are not used by verify_staging_delivery.py or state generation. Previews were already behind Vercel Authentication. Reversible by reverting the file.
DECISIONS.md records the owner authorization and the preview decision; STAGING_DELIVERY.md documents the preview change; route_inventory.md reflects the new access.

resources: Railway API service optcg-price-tracker (watch services/api/** -> build at merge)
Railway market-index-snapshot cron image (same watch pattern; daily 0 20 * * * UTC, not run by deploy)
impact.deployment_impact: API and market-index-snapshot rebuild from the merge (Railway watch patterns read 2026-10-10 ~04:00Z); worker, beat and all 10 collectors watch only their own directories and are not rebuilt. No collector rollout requested, no migration (head stays f9e5b4a8c012), no variable, schedule, budget, writer or source-job change.

recovery.procedure: Open a PR reverting this merge into staging; the API and frontend redeploy the previous code through the same delivery path. No database or provider-variable action.
recovery.trigger: Admin market/digest pages fail for an admin session, any public catalogue/market route starts answering 401, the delivery verifier fails, or any collector deployment/digest/setting changes.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no persistent state, schema, variable or deployment-setting change.

verification.observation_window: The staging delivery of this merge: API built at the merge, both component checks pass on 1b1b64d, no collector rollout; then unauthenticated GETs of the private routes and invalid-id writes answer 401 on API and web, public catalogue routes still 200, admin pages load, and all 10 collectors remain on their activation deployments and digests with daily-v1.
